lines.en: label sanaspring6:
I knock on Sana’s door and-
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Sana 的门，然后——

lines.en: : {i}Aaaah! Sana...wait! I wasn’t ready yet! You need to warn me before — ngh?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊！Sana……等等！我还没准备好呢！你好歹提前说一声啊——ngh？！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just...a little more!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再……再撑一下下！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s too...tight! I can’t...handle it!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}太……太紧了！我……我受不了了！{/i}

lines.en: ...and I think I’m just going to stand out here for a little while and give those two some space.
lines.zh: ……我想我还是先在外面站一会儿，给那两位留点空间吧。

lines.en: : {i}Almost...there!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}快……快好了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hngh! I feel like...I’m about to...burst!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Hngh！我总觉得……我快要……撑爆了！{/i}

lines.en: Wait, why on earth would I give them their space when I could just invade it instead?
lines.zh: 等等，我明明可以直接闯进去，凭什么还要给她们留空间啊？

lines.en: scene black
: I’m coming in. Don’t finish without-
lines.zh: : 我进来了。没我不许结束啊——

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes1
: There. It’s finally on now. You should be able to breathe again.
lines.zh: : 好了。总算穿上了。你现在应该能喘上气了吧。

lines.en: : Phew...I hope I’m not gaining weight. Are corsets always like this? Because I’ve gained a newfound respect for you today if they are.
lines.zh: : 呼……希望我没有长胖。紧身胸衣一直都是这样的吗？如果是的话，我今天可对你生出了一份全新的敬意。

lines.en: : This one’s too big for me. Mine actually fit, so it’s only a little hard to-
lines.zh: : 这件对我来说太大了。我自己的其实很合身，所以只是有那么一点点难——

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene sanaayaneclothes2
: Oh, Sensei...When did you walk in?
lines.zh: : 啊，老师……你什么时候进来的？

lines.en: : As soon as all the fun stopped, unfortunately. And, despite this not being the sight I wanted to see, I am still thankful I get to see Ayane dressed in...whatever she is currently dressed in.
lines.zh: : 很不巧，刚好在最有意思的部分结束的时候。而且，尽管眼前这幕并不是我想看的，我还是很庆幸能看到 Ayane 穿着……她现在身上这身不知该怎么形容的东西。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe gave some of her old clothes to Sana and-
lines.zh: : Watabe 小姐把她的一些旧衣服给了 Sana，然后——

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes3
: MNGH?!?!? SANA?!
lines.zh: : MNGH?!?!? SANA?!

lines.en: : Sorry. Just making sure it’s on all the way.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是确认一下是不是真的穿到位了。

lines.en: : Maybe tug it once more for good measure.
lines.zh: : 保险起见，再使劲拽一下。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes4
: If Sensei thinks that’s best...
lines.zh: : 如果老师觉得这样最好的话……

lines.en: : Don’t! I’ll literally die! I can already feel my insides being crushed as we speak!
lines.zh: : 别！我真的会死的！我现在就已经能感觉到内脏在被压碎了！

lines.en: : Mm...that sounds nice.
lines.zh: : 嗯……听起来不错。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not! Sensei, stop her!
lines.zh: : 才不是呢！老师，快拦住她！

lines.en: : Call me what you’re supposed to be calling me now.
lines.zh: : 叫我你现在应该叫的那个称呼。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes5
: Akira, stop her! My control over Sana has long since vanished and you’re the only one who can silence this demon now!
lines.zh: : Akira，快拦住她！我对 Sana 的控制早就失效了，现在只有你能让这个恶魔闭嘴了！

lines.en: : If I tighten it any more, it might snap. So let’s just say you’ve lucked out this time.
lines.zh: : 再收紧一点可能就要崩开了。所以就当你这次走运吧。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes6
: Wh...What are you doing here anyway? If I’d have known you were coming, I would have waited for another night to let Sana play dress-up with my body.
lines.zh: : 你……你到底来这儿干什么？我要是早知道你要来，就会换个晚上再让 Sana 拿我的身体玩换装游戏了。

lines.en: : Like Ayane was saying before I stimulated her, a lot of the clothes Miss Watabe gave me are a little too big. So we thought it’d be fun if she tried them on instead.
lines.zh: : 就像 Ayane 在我刺激她之前说的那样，Watabe 小姐给我的很多衣服都有点太大了。所以我们觉得，让她来试穿应该会很有意思。

lines.en: : Is...{i}stimulated{/i} really the right word to be using there?
lines.zh: : 「{i}刺激{/i}」这个词……用在这里真的合适吗？

lines.en: : Whatever the circumstances, I wouldn’t mind you dressing like this more often, Ayane. Same goes for that dress you wore at the last Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，我不介意你多穿成这样几次，Ayane。上次宿舍大战时你穿的那条裙子也是一样。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes7
: Th...This feels a...lot more embarrassing than...that did for...some reason...
lines.zh: : 这……这不知怎么的，比那次……还要让人难为情得多……

lines.en: : Are girls who wear things like this really your type after all? Am I actually {i}losing{/i} points by dressing less...conservatively now?
lines.zh: : 穿这种衣服的女生真的是你喜欢的类型吗？那我现在穿得没那么……保守，是不是就在{i}掉分{/i}了？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say you’re {i}losing{/i} points. But there is a certain allure that comes from layer after layer of clothing. Like you need to work harder to see what’s beneath it all.
lines.zh: : 我不会说你在{i}掉分{/i}。不过一层又一层的衣服确实有某种魅力。就像你得花更多力气，才能看到底下藏着什么。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes8
: I’m surprised you like Ayane in these, then. I figured you’d have her body memorized by now.
lines.zh: : 那你喜欢 Ayane 穿成这样，我还挺意外的。我以为你早就把她的身体背下来了。

lines.en: : Oh, I most definitely do. But all of the ties and ribbons are like enrichment for me because I am an animal at my core.
lines.zh: : 哦，那是当然。但那些系带和丝带对我来说就像丰容玩具，因为我骨子里就是头牲口。

lines.en: : I feel very objectified right now. Which isn’t to say I dislike it. I just also want to curl up in a ball and burst into flames since I didn’t have the time to mentally prepare myself to be seen like-
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉自己被彻底物化了。倒不是说我不喜欢。我只是也想蜷成一团原地自燃，因为我根本没时间做好被这样看见的心理准备——

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes9
: Aaah! Sana! I...thought you said it was all the way in!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！Sana！我……我以为你说已经完全穿进去了！

lines.en: : Don’t you mean “on?”
lines.zh: : 你是不是想说「穿上」？

lines.en: : Th...That’s what I said!
lines.zh: : 我……我就是这么说的！

lines.en: : Let her go before you kill her, Sana.
lines.zh: : 在她被你弄死之前先松开她，Sana。

lines.en: : You’re just jealous that you aren’t the only person who can make her make noises like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 你只是嫉妒罢了，嫉妒自己不再是唯一能让她发出那种声音的人了。

lines.en: : That is very likely true on a subconscious level, so I will not outright deny it and just say “please” instead.
lines.zh: : 这话在潜意识层面很可能是真的，所以我不会直接否认，只说一句「拜托了」。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it. Even I can’t help but fawn over her when she looks so out of character. It’s like I’m seeing something I’m not supposed to right now.
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的。就连我在她这么不像平时的样子时也忍不住想疼她。就像我现在正在看着什么不该看的东西。

lines.en: : Is that why you’re still holding me hostage? Let go of the corset! There’s only one person who’s allowed to put me on a leash and it’s Sensei!
lines.zh: : 所以你还扣着我不放？松开胸衣！能给我套上项圈的只有一个人，那就是老师！

lines.en: : Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: : You both know what I mean! I-
lines.zh: : 你们俩都懂我的意思！我——

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes10
: Free at last...
lines.zh: : 终于自由了……

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes11
: Ack!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s how I always feel at the end of the day too.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我在一天结束的时候也一直是这种感觉。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes12
: So how many of these have you worn? What percentage of the fashion show have I missed?
lines.zh: : 那么你已经穿了几件了？这场时装秀我错过了百分之多少？

lines.en: : This is the fourth, I think. Miss Watabe gave Sana a {i}lot.{/i} Some of it seems really high quality, too.
lines.zh: : 我想这是第四件了。Watabe 小姐给了 Sana {i}很多{/i}。有些看起来质量还相当好。

lines.en: : Well, she was a rich girl at one point, so that only makes sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她好歹也曾是个有钱人家的小姐，这就说得通了。

lines.en: : I’m technically a rich girl too and I still buy most of my clothes off SHEIN.
lines.zh: : 严格来说我也算有钱人家的小姐，可我大部分衣服还是在 SHEIN 上买的。

lines.en: : Am I supposed to know what that is?
lines.zh: : 我该知道那是什么吗？

lines.en: : Only if you want to buy me a birthday present this year. I’ll wear anything you pick out.
lines.zh: : 如果你想今年送我生日礼物的话就该知道。你挑什么我都穿。

lines.en: : I’m not really the best when it comes to fashion, as I’m sure you’ve noticed.
lines.zh: : 我在时尚这方面确实不怎么样，你肯定早就看出来了。

lines.en: : They have lingerie too.
lines.zh: : 他们家也卖内衣。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 那我看看吧。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes13
: Sana, what are-
lines.zh: : Sana，你在——

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes14
: Oh my God! What do you think you’re doing?!
lines.zh: : 我的天啊！你这是在干什么？！

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes15
: Huh? Getting undressed.
lines.zh: : 嗯？脱衣服啊。

lines.en: : Right in front of us?!
lines.zh: : 当着我们的面？！

lines.en: : Yeah...It’s no fair if only you get to dress out of character. I want to make Sensei’s heart pound too.
lines.zh: : 对啊……只有你能穿得不像自己，太不公平了。我也想让老师心跳加速。

lines.en: : I would like my heart to pound as well, but Ayane is currently obscuring my vision and should stop if she knows what’s good for her.
lines.zh: : 我也想心跳加速，但 Ayane 现在正挡着我的视线，她要是识相的话就该让开。

lines.en: : Have sex with her all you want, but watching her get undressed is a different level of lewd that shouldn’t be normalized!
lines.zh: : 你想跟她怎么做都行，但看着她脱衣服是另一种程度的色情，不该被当成常态！

lines.en: : Can I at least put on your clothes before I have sex with him?
lines.zh: : 那我至少可以先穿上你的衣服，再跟他做吧？

lines.en: : Wait, {i}my{/i} clothes? Why do you want to put on my clothes?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}我的{/i}衣服？你为什么要穿我的衣服？

lines.en: : Because I don’t have anything brightly colored, obviously. You still have some of your clothes from middle school under the bed, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 因为我根本没有颜色鲜亮的衣服啊，这不是明摆着吗。你床底下还留着些中学时候的衣服吧？

lines.en: : I do, but-
lines.zh: : 是有，可是——

lines.en: : Go, Sana. Strip. Do not listen to this girl, for she does not understand the gravity of what is happening right now.
lines.zh: : 去吧，Sana。脱。别听这丫头的，因为她根本不懂眼下这件事有多重大。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes16

: {size=-2}Of course I understand the gravity of what’s happening right now! Nobody appreciates Sana’s cuteness more than me and she’s about to wear {i}my{/i} clothes! Do you have any idea how excited I am?! I can barely contain it! {/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我当然懂眼下这件事有多重大！没有人比我更懂得欣赏 Sana 的可爱了，而她马上就要穿上{i}我的{/i}衣服了！你知道我有多兴奋吗？！我简直快按捺不住了！{/size}

lines.en: : Okay, maybe you {i}do{/i} get it then.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那看来你{i}确实{/i}懂。

lines.en: : I do! And it’s {i}because{/i} I get it that we shouldn’t be looking at her at all until she’s dressed up or it’ll just ruin the surprise!
lines.zh: : 我懂！正{i}因为{/i}懂，所以在她穿好之前我们根本不该看她，不然就破坏惊喜了！

lines.en: : See, now you’ve lost me again.
lines.zh: : 你看，这下我又听不懂了。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes17
: Sana, how about we just leave the room and-
lines.zh: : Sana，要不我们先出房间——

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes18
: {i}{b}JESUS CHRIST!{/i}{/b}
lines.zh: : {i}{b}老天爷啊！{/b}{/i}

lines.en: : Is literally {i}everything{/i} you’ve ever worn blue? You don’t have any other colors at all?
lines.zh: : 你穿过的东西真的{i}全都{/i}是蓝色的吗？你就没有别的颜色的衣服？

lines.en: : Have you no decency?! You’re not even wearing panties!
lines.zh: : 你还有没有廉耻心？！你连内裤都没穿！

lines.en: : What do you mean? The only reason I’m covering myself up is because you keep freaking out about it. Is that not decency?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？我之所以遮着，就是因为你会一直大惊小怪啊。这难道还不算廉耻吗？

lines.en: : You’re barely covered up at all! If the camera angle shifts even a little bit, it’ll reveal literally everything!
lines.zh: : 你根本就没遮住多少！镜头角度哪怕只偏一点点，就什么都露出来了！

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes19
: Oh. Well, I guess there’s no point in trying to hide anything then. Do you think that sundress you wore in elementary school would fit me?
lines.zh: : 哦。那看来也没什么好藏的了。你觉得你小学时候穿的那条背带裙我穿得下吗？

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes20
: Yes.
: As a matter of fact, I do...
lines.zh: : 事实上，我还真有……

lines.en: : E...Elementary school?...
: I sure hope it’s not too big...
lines.zh: : 真希望不会太大……

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes21
: Too...big?...
: Eyes over here, future husband. You’re already on thin ice for...well...literally everything you have ever done.
lines.zh: : 眼睛看这边，未来的老公。你早就已经如履薄冰了——因为……嗯……因为你做过的每一件事。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes22
: I’m sorry and I love you.
lines.zh: : 对不起，还有我爱你。

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: : Great. So, since we love each other, I think it only makes sense if we watch her get dressed together as it will help strengthen our bond.
lines.zh: : 太好了。既然我们彼此相爱，那我觉得我们一起看她穿衣服就很合情合理了，因为这能加深我们的羁绊。

lines.en: : How will watching my naked roommate put on my old clothes strengthen our bond?
lines.zh: : 看着我裸着的室友穿上我的旧衣服，怎么就能加深我们的羁绊了？

lines.en: : Because we bond through sex and watching her will strengthen my penis.
lines.zh: : 因为我们是靠做爱来加深感情的，而看着她能让我的阴茎更强。

lines.en: : That actually somehow makes sense to me.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么的，我觉得这话还挺有道理。

lines.en: : I’m going to interpret that as permission to look then.
lines.zh: : 那我就当是你允许我看了。

lines.en: : Do you want to just make out instead? Because it’s been a while and I think it would help calm me down.
lines.zh: : 要不我们干脆接吻算了？毕竟好久没亲了，我觉得那样能让我冷静下来。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Watch your words very closely right now, Akira. There are many wrong things to say and very few correct ones.
lines.zh: : Akira，现在措辞给我小心点。能说的错话有很多，对的话却少得可怜。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes23
: Excuse me, but...
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，不过……

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes24
: I’d actually prefer it if you guys paid a little more attention to me instead of each other now, thanks.
lines.zh: : 其实我更希望你们俩现在多关注关注我，而不是彼此，谢谢。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes25
: Did...Did we die?
lines.zh: : 我们……我们是不是死了？

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : We died, right? And this is Heaven. Because that is an angel. I know an angel when I see one.
lines.zh: : 我们死了，对吧？这里是天堂。因为那是个天使。我一眼就能认出天使。

lines.en: : Am I cute? Did I make your hearts skip a beat?
lines.zh: : 我可爱吗？有没有让你们心跳漏一拍？

lines.en: : Marry me.
lines.zh: : 跟我结婚吧。

lines.en: : I thought I was supposed to marry you?
lines.zh: : 我还以为要跟我结婚的是你呢？

lines.en: : I changed my mind. I want Sana now.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。我现在想要 Sana。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes26
: I’m not really sure how much I like this. I feel very...exposed right now. Are these types of dresses always this...airy?
lines.zh: : 我也不知道自己有多喜欢这个。我现在感觉特别……暴露。这种裙子一直都这么……通风吗？

lines.en: : You’re...You {i}are{/i} wearing panties now, right?
lines.zh: : 你……你{i}现在{/i}穿内裤了吧，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes27
: Ohhhhhhh...I guess that {i}would{/i} explain it.
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢噢……我想这{i}就是{/i}原因了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}Okay, Sensei. You’re back at the top of the marriage list.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……好吧，老师。你重新回到结婚名单的第一位了。

lines.en: : I’m not wearing underwear either.
lines.zh: : 我也没穿内裤。

lines.en: : You both disgust me. And you leave me no choice but to take off mine as well.
lines.zh: : 你们俩真让我恶心。而且你们逼得我别无选择，只能把我的也脱了。

lines.en: scene black
scene sanaayaneclothes28
Now, you’re probably wondering how I wound up in this situation.
lines.zh: 现在，你们大概在想，我怎么会落得这步田地。

lines.en: And the reason you’re probably wondering that is because I know firsthand just how hard it’s been to focus with these two being as cute as they have been tonight.
lines.zh: 你们会这么想，是因为我比谁都清楚，今晚这两个人可爱成这样，我有多难集中注意力。

lines.en: But I can say with utmost certainty that my struggles are, in no way, close to ending since the only reason I haven’t thrown myself at them is because I know Ayane doesn’t like threesomes.
lines.zh: 但我可以非常确定地说，我的苦战远远谈不上结束，因为我没有扑上去的唯一理由，就是我知道 Ayane 不喜欢三人行。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes29
: I know what you’re thinking and I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我知道你在想什么，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : I also know what you’re thinking and I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我也知道你在想什么，我可一点都不。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes30
: Life is pain. This much, I have already come to accept.
lines.zh: : 人生就是痛苦。这一点，我早就接受了。

lines.en: : You know...maybe you and I {i}should{/i} try out some new styles, Sana? It’s pretty boring wearing the same thing all the time, right?
lines.zh: : 你说……Sana，或许你和我{i}该{/i}试试些新风格？老穿一样的衣服挺无聊的，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes31
: We should go shopping together. There are a bunch of new shops at the mall, and I’m sure most of them have youth sections.
lines.zh: : 我们应该一起去逛街。商场里新开了好多店，我敢肯定大部分都有少女区。

lines.en: : Youth sections...
lines.zh: : 少女区……

lines.en: : I’d say we should bring Sensei along as well, but I’m not sure he’d be able to contain himself.
lines.zh: : 我也想说把老师一起带上，但我不确定他能不能把持住自己。

lines.en: : I agree. In fact, I imagine this is a pretty intense test of self-control right now. We seem to be appealing to him in ways I’m not sure he ever thought we would.
lines.zh: : 我同意。说真的，我想这对他现在来说是一场相当严峻的自制力考验。我们似乎正以他自己都想不到的方式吸引着他。

lines.en: : This rivalry is really ramping up, isn’t it? I can’t help but wonder who will end up {i}on top.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这场较量真是越来越激烈了，不是吗？我忍不住想知道最后谁会{i}占上风{/i}。

lines.en: : Why, yes. In fact, it seems quite possible that there may even be some sort of come {i}from behind{/i} victory.
lines.zh: : 哦，没错。事实上，甚至还很有可能出现某种{i}后发制人{/i}的逆转。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, it’ll be a {i}really tight{/i} race all the way to the finish line.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，一直到终点都会是一场{i}咬得很紧{/i}的比赛。

lines.en: : It sure will. But I’m sure we’ll reach a {i}happy ending{/i} regardless.
lines.zh: : 那是当然。不过我相信不管怎样我们都会走到一个{i}圆满的结局{/i}。

lines.en: : Have I mentioned lately that I hate both of you?
lines.zh: : 我最近有没有说过，我恨你们俩？

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes32
: You don’t need to when it’s written all over your face like that. And, if it makes you feel better, I’m sure we’ll be keeping these outfits for use during more...{i}private{/i} encounters.
lines.zh: : 你不用说了，全都写在你脸上了。还有，如果能让你好受点的话，我敢肯定这些衣服我们会留着，在更……{i}私密{/i}的场合穿。

lines.en: : I might need help putting this one on again, though. It is...{i}slightly{/i} more complicated than a sundress.
lines.zh: : 不过这一件我可能得有人帮忙才穿得回去。它……比背带裙{i}稍微{/i}复杂一点。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes33
: You look great, though...I’m sure Miss Watabe would be really happy to see her old clothes put to such good use.
lines.zh: : 不过你穿起来很好看……我相信 Watabe 小姐看到自己的旧衣服被这样好好利用，一定会很高兴。

lines.en: : Sorry only a couple of them fit you right now, Sana. You’ll grow into them eventually. Maybe. The world has a weird way of both working and {i}not{/i} working sometimes.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sana，现在只有几件合你的身。你迟早会长到能穿的。大概吧。这个世界有时候就是既讲道理又{i}不讲道理{/i}。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes34
: I guess so. I’ll probably grow a little more...But the chances of me ever being bigger than my mom are kind of slim, I think. She says I’m smaller than she was at this age.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我应该还会再长一点点……但我想我长得比我妈还大的可能性挺小的。她说我在这个年纪比她当时还小。

lines.en: : So unless I have a sudden growth spurt or something...you can probably count on me being pocket-size forever.
lines.zh: : 所以除非我突然猛长个子什么的……你大概可以指望我一直这么小巧玲珑下去了。

lines.en: : What do you think, {i}Akira?{/i} Are you excited to see Sana and I when we’re all grown up?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，{i}Akira{/i}？你期待看到我和 Sana 长大后的样子吗？

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes35
scene sanaayaneclothes36
: Something tells me he’s going to look exactly the same fifteen years from now...and that {i}you’ll{/i} wind up mature and beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得，十五年后的他会长得跟现在一模一样……而{i}你会{/i}变得成熟又美丽。

lines.en: : Are you saying I’m not mature and beautiful now, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，你是在说我现在还不够成熟漂亮吗？

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes37
scene sanaayaneclothes36
: Of course not. Just that you’ll get even {i}more{/i} beautiful as time goes by.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。只是说你会随着时间变得{i}更{/i}美。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes38
: {b}BUT I WILL ALWAYS BE THERE, WAITING FOR THE CHANCE TO STRIKE AND TAKE WHAT IS RIGHTFULLY MINE.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}但我永远都在那里，等着时机出手，夺回理应属于我的东西。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}IT MATTERS NOT, THE WAY YOU AGE. THE THINGS YOU’LL SEE OR WON’T. WHAT MATTERS MOST IS SUSTENANCE. WHAT MATTERS MOST IS HOPE.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你如何老去并不重要。你会看到什么、又不会看到什么，也不重要。最重要的是养料。最重要的是希望。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}WILT LIKE A FLOWER. BURN LIKE THE SUN.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}如花般凋零。如烈日般燃烧。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}AND WHEN IT ALL GOES AWAY, REMEMBER — IT DIDN’T HAVE TO BE LIKE THIS.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}当一切消散之时，请记住——本不必如此。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}IT COULD’VE BEEN ME.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}本可以是我的。{/b}

lines.en: scene threeflowers
scene sanaayaneclothes39
scene black
scene sanaayaneclothes40
Ayane went to sleep at some point.
lines.zh: Ayane 在某个时候睡着了。

lines.en: I can’t exactly remember when.
lines.zh: 我记不太清是什么时候。

lines.en: scene black
scene sanaayaneclothes41
But this one’s still awake.
lines.zh: 但这个还醒着。

lines.en: Still wearing her clothes.
lines.zh: 还穿着她的衣服。

lines.en: Still resting her head on my shoulder.
lines.zh: 还把头靠在我肩上。

lines.en: Still waiting for me to strike.
lines.zh: 还在等着我出手。

lines.en: But I can’t.
lines.zh: 但我做不到。

lines.en: I can’t do anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都做不了。

lines.en: I can’t find the words.
lines.zh: 我找不到合适的词。

lines.en: I don’t know which ones to even look for.
lines.zh: 我甚至不知道该去找哪些词。

lines.en: You’d think that I would know by now how to tell someone I’m afraid of them.
lines.zh: 你会以为，到了现在我总该知道该怎么告诉别人我害怕他们了。

lines.en: Or rather, that they do things that scare me.
lines.zh: 或者说，是他们做的某些事让我害怕。

lines.en: Whether it be intentional or not is another question entirely.
lines.zh: 至于这些事是有意还是无意，那就是另一个问题了。

lines.en: But there is a presence in this room.
lines.zh: 但这个房间里有一个存在。

lines.en: A fourth one.
lines.zh: 第四个。

lines.en: That’s either been here for some time or crept in when I opened the door.
lines.zh: 它要么已经在这里待了一段时间，要么就是在我开门的时候溜进来的。

lines.en: It wears the same dress she does.
lines.zh: 它穿着和她一样的裙子。

lines.en: Whispers things into my ear that come out garbled.
lines.zh: 凑到我耳边低语，说出来的话却含混不清。

lines.en: Gargled.
lines.zh: 像在漱口。

lines.en: Spit me out.
lines.zh: 把我吐出来。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : There...
lines.zh: : 好了……

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} said it this time.
lines.zh: : 这次{i}我{/i}说出口了。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes42
: You don’t have to feel bad about it anymore.
lines.zh: : 你不用再为这件事内疚了。

lines.en: : And I won’t even make you say it back.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不会逼你说回来。

lines.en: : But it’s the truth.
lines.zh: : 可这是真的。

lines.en: scene sanaayaneclothes41
: You and me...
lines.zh: : 你和我……

lines.en: : Will be together forever...
lines.zh: : 会永远在一起……

lines.en: : No matter where...
lines.zh: : 无论身在何处……

lines.en: scene black
: No matter when.
lines.zh: : 无论何时。
